sloka: अन्तरिक्षे च वागुक्ता प्रति मा ऽमानुषी किल ।एवमेतन्नरपते धर्मेण तनया तव ॥ २.११८.३१॥
transliteration: antarikṣe ca vāguktā prati mā 'mānuṣī kila ।evametannarapate dharmeṇa tanayā tava ॥ 2.118.31॥

translations.english: 'O king, she is an incomparable divine being. By right she is your daughter'. These were the words (Janaka) heard from out of the sky.
